adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `addMembers` action just calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` and returns nothing/doesn’t attach a `.catch()` or `.then()` for UI state, and the template button isn’t disabled while the request is in-flight. There’s also an explicit `// TODO: should clear the input`, and the input is never cleared, so repeated clicks can resend the same usernames. However, whether failures are truly “silent” can’t be proven from this diff alone (there may be a global AJAX error handler elsewhere), so it’s best treated as a concrete UX/resiliency gap introduced by the change rather than a strictly verifiable functional defect.
